attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 10), installed nginx + openssl, configured nginx to serve HTTPS on port 8443 using a self-signed certificate stored under /etc/pki/tls/rotating, and set up a systemd oneshot service (cert-renew.service) fired every 5 minutes by cert-renew.timer to regenerate the certificate and reload nginx (zero-downtime reload, no restart). Verified automatic renewal, continuous request availability across a live cert swap, and that the automation and TLS endpoint both recover intact across a full node restart.
